summary: Zepp Health filed a 6-K reporting Q1 2026 unaudited financial results. Revenue was $51.5M (+33.8% YoY), gross margin 37.7%; cash and equivalents $103.2M. Management guided Q2 revenue of $63M-$68M (+6-14% YoY). New products and a HYROX partnership were announced. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation.
